P4310320595.name: Wiley
P4310320595.note: Publisher-level pages. Green OA embargo is 12-24 months depending on the journal; society-owned titles may set their own terms - confirm on the journal's own page.

P4310319900.name: Springer Nature
P4310319900.note: Publisher-level pages; APC varies by journal (see the journal website's Open Access Fees and Funding section). Self-archiving embargo is typically up to 12 months.

P4310319798.name: Association for Computing Machinery (ACM)
P4310319798.note: ACM moved to fully open access on 2026-01-01 under the ACM Open model; APCs apply to authors at non-participating institutions. There is effectively no green-OA embargo (immediate OA). Policies are publisher-level (ACM does not publish per-journal policy pages); journal home pages are on the ACM Digital Library (dl.acm.org).

P4310311721.name: Cambridge University Press
P4310311721.note: Green OA embargo is typically 6 months (science/medical) to 12 months (humanities/social science) - confirm on the journal's own page.

P4310320006.name: American Chemical Society (ACS)
P4310320006.note: Standard green OA embargo is 12 months for hybrid journals; a zero-embargo green OA option exists (see the sharing/public-access page). APC/pricing is via the ACS pricing estimator, not a flat per-journal list.

P4310320083.name: Institute of Physics (IOP)
P4310320083.note: Green OA embargo is 12 months (subscription articles). Full APC price list is downloadable from the APC page; preprints may be shared any time.

P4310320556.name: Royal Society of Chemistry
P4310320556.note: Green OA embargo is 12 months. Gold OA APCs listed on the payments page; RSC members get a 15% discount.

P4310320497.name: Microbiology Society
P4310320497.note: Green OA (self-archiving) and APC terms are on the linked publisher pages; the accepted manuscript may be deposited, and NIH-mandated deposits are allowed with zero embargo.

P4310311847.name: The Company of Biologists
P4310311847.note: Publisher-level pages covering all five journals (Development, Journal of Cell Science, Journal of Experimental Biology, Disease Models & Mechanisms, Biology Open). Self-archiving of the accepted manuscript is allowed (including zero-embargo PMC deposit for NIH compliance) where standard routes do not meet a mandate; the 12-month subscribe-to-open window applies to the three transformative journals. APCs are set per journal - see the linked Journals Gateway open-access overview.

P4310315909.name: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press
P4310315909.note: Publisher-level pages covering the four research journals (Genes & Development, Genome Research, RNA, Learning & Memory), which are Transformative Journals. Articles become free 6 months after publication under the standard subscription route; immediate OA is available via an APC or a transformative agreement. Pre/post-prints may be self-archived; complies with NIH Public Access (6-month). No single general self-archiving page was found on cshlpress.com (per-journal terms pages exist instead), so embargo_sharing points to the CSHL Press landing page.

P4310318509.name: Cogitatio Press
P4310318509.note: Fully open access (all five journals) under CC BY with no embargo; authors retain copyright; SHERPA/RoMEO Green Publisher status. Links go to the publisher's general About page (open access + self-archiving policy) and Institutional Membership page (APC waivers for member institutions); per-journal editorial-policies pages carry the same terms.

P4310320990.name: Elsevier
P4310320990.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. Preprints may be shared any time; the accepted manuscript may go in an institutional repository only after that journal's embargo, which Elsevier sets per title (see the embargo list linked from the sharing page) rather than as one blanket period. APCs also vary by journal - the pricing page links a full price list.

P4310320547.name: Taylor & Francis
P4310320547.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. Green OA embargo on the accepted manuscript is typically 12 months for science, technology and medicine titles and 18 months for social sciences and humanities. A zero-embargo green option exists for authors with funder mandates - worth checking if you must deposit immediately.

P4310319847.name: Routledge (Taylor & Francis)
P4310319847.note: Routledge is a Taylor & Francis imprint and follows the same policies. Green OA embargo is typically 18 months for social sciences and humanities (most Routledge titles) and 12 months for science and medicine. A zero-embargo green option exists for funder-mandated deposits.

P4310320017.name: SAGE Publishing
P4310320017.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. The accepted version of a subscription article may be posted to an institutional repository for non-commercial, no-derivative use; embargo length is set per journal, so confirm on the journal's own page. Automatic APC waivers apply for authors in Research4Life Group A countries and 50% discounts for Group B.

P4310311648.name: Oxford University Press
P4310311648.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. The standard green OA embargo is 12 months from online publication for the accepted manuscript, but OUP runs several self-archiving policies and embargoes differ by journal - check your title on the embargo periods page before depositing.

P4310313990.name: De Gruyter Brill
P4310313990.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. The submitted preprint may be self-archived at any time; the version of record may go in a repository after a 12-month embargo for subscription and closed-access hybrid articles. Note this green route does not satisfy Plan S - publish gold if your funder requires immediate OA.

P4310320322.name: De Gruyter Open
P4310320322.note: De Gruyter's fully open access imprint, now part of De Gruyter Brill. Articles are open on publication with no embargo, so self-archiving is unrestricted. APC varies by journal.

P4310319808.name: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)
P4310319808.note: Hybrid journals, fully open access topical journals, and IEEE Access. Authors may post the accepted manuscript to a personal or employer site, and green OA deposit in a funder-mandated public repository is allowed at no charge. APC is about $2,160 for fully OA titles and $2,800 for hybrid, with IEEE member discounts.

P4310319811.name: Emerald Publishing
P4310319811.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. Emerald has offered zero-embargo green OA since 2014: the accepted manuscript may be deposited immediately on publication under CC BY-NC at no charge, which satisfies most funder mandates without an APC. CC BY on the accepted manuscript requires a paid APC or an institutional agreement.

P4310315671.name: Lippincott Williams & Wilkins (Wolters Kluwer)
P4310315671.note: Mostly subscription and hybrid medical journals. Green OA embargo on the accepted manuscript is 12 months where the journal offers an open access option and 6 months where it does not, deposited under CC BY-NC. LWW deposits NIH-funded articles to PubMed Central on the author's behalf.

P4310320256.name: BioMed Central (Springer Nature)
P4310320256.note: Fully open access. Articles publish immediately open under CC BY with authors retaining copyright, so there is no embargo and self-archiving is unrestricted. Eligible articles are deposited to PubMed Central automatically. APC varies by journal; waivers exist for member institutions and demonstrated hardship.

P4310310987.name: MDPI
P4310310987.note: Fully open access. All articles publish immediately under CC BY with no embargo, and authors retain copyright without signing a transfer, so any version may be deposited in a repository at any time. APC varies by journal; discounts and waivers are available.

P4310320527.name: Frontiers Media
P4310320527.note: Fully open access. Articles publish immediately under CC BY with authors retaining copyright, so there is no embargo on self-archiving. Publishing fees vary by journal and article type and are payable only on acceptance; discounts are available for authors in low and lower-middle income countries.

P4310319869.name: Hindawi (Wiley)
P4310319869.note: All Hindawi journals are fully open access, now published under Wiley. Articles are open on publication, so there is no embargo on self-archiving. APCs apply per journal, with automatic Research4Life waivers and discounts for authors in low- and middle-income countries.

P4310320561.name: Brill (De Gruyter Brill)
P4310320561.note: Hybrid journals, now part of De Gruyter Brill. Hybrid gold OA carries an APC of about EUR 2,400 with authors retaining copyright under CC BY; institutional agreements can cover it. The green route is free: the version of record may be self-archived after a 12-month embargo.

P4310317820.name: Karger Publishers
P4310317820.note: Hybrid and fully open access biomedical journals. Preprints may be shared without restriction; the accepted manuscript may go in a public repository after a 12-month embargo (or as the funder requires), and non-commercial posting to a personal page or institutional repository is permitted. APC varies by journal, roughly EUR 3,800-4,400 at the top end.

P4310320262.name: American Psychological Association (APA)
P4310320262.note: Subscription and hybrid journals with green and gold routes. APA's posting guidelines allow the accepted manuscript on personal sites, institutional repositories, PsyArXiv, and author networks with no embargo, provided the copyright notice and a DOI link to the version of record are included. Gold OA via APC or an institutional Read-and-Publish agreement.

P4310319815.name: World Scientific
P4310319815.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. Preprints may be posted anywhere at any time; the accepted manuscript may go in a repository 12 months after publication. Gold OA (CC BY or CC BY-NC) removes the embargo entirely and authors retain copyright. APC varies by journal.

P4310321135.name: Georg Thieme Verlag
P4310321135.note: Hybrid and fully open access medical journals. Open access articles may be deposited anywhere immediately under their CC license; for subscription articles the accepted manuscript may go in a non-commercial institutional repository no earlier than 12 months after publication. Complies with the NIH Public Access Policy.

P4310320000.name: Thieme Medical Publishers
P4310320000.note: Part of the Thieme Group; same policies as Georg Thieme Verlag. OA articles may be deposited immediately; subscription-article accepted manuscripts carry a 12-month embargo for institutional repositories. Complies with the NIH Public Access Policy.

P4310320443.name: Mary Ann Liebert, Inc.
P4310320443.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals with a notably permissive green route: the accepted manuscript may be posted to an institutional repository, funder repository, or personal website immediately on publication, with no embargo and no charge. APCs apply only if you choose gold OA; Research4Life waivers and discounts available.

P4310320448.name: Medknow (Wolters Kluwer)
P4310320448.note: Open access society journals, mostly from medical societies in India and Asia. Most titles charge no APC and provide immediate free access to full text; self-archiving is permitted. Policies vary by journal - confirm on the journal's own page.

P4310319908.name: Nature Portfolio (Springer Nature)
P4310319908.note: Nature-branded subscription, hybrid, and fully OA journals. Subscription-route authors may self-archive the accepted manuscript on a personal site or in funder/institutional repositories for public release 6 months after publication. Gold OA (CC BY, APC varies by journal) removes the embargo.

P4310315672.name: University of Chicago Press
P4310315672.note: Subscription and hybrid journals with portfolio-wide green OA: the accepted manuscript or published PDF may be deposited in a non-commercial repository and made freely available 12 months after publication; funder mandates with shorter embargoes are honored for the accepted manuscript only. Each journal has its own 'Open Access at Chicago' page - check it for gold OA fees.

P4310317825.name: Inderscience Publishers
P4310317825.note: Subscription journals with a gold OA option (APC around EUR 2,200-3,300). OA authors retain copyright under CC BY and may post the version of record to non-commercial repositories with no embargo. For non-OA articles, check the copyright page for what may be shared.

P4310320348.name: Dove Medical Press (Taylor & Francis)
P4310320348.note: Fully open access medical journals, part of Taylor & Francis. Articles publish immediately under CC BY-NC (CC BY available for certain funders) with authors retaining copyright, so there is no embargo. APC varies by journal; full waivers and 50% discounts apply for authors in low-income economies.

P4310319748.name: EDP Sciences
P4310319748.note: Society-owned journals, many fully OA or under Subscribe-to-Open. Green OA is unusually generous: all versions (submitted, accepted, and version of record) may be deposited in institutional or subject repositories without embargo, under the article's license. Publication charges vary by journal.

P4310320424.name: IGI Global
P4310320424.note: Open access and hybrid journals, including diamond OA titles with no APC. OA articles publish under CC BY 4.0 with authors keeping copyright; the fair-use policy also lets authors post the final typeset PDF on a personal site or university repository. Where funders require it, the accepted manuscript may be deposited under CC BY.

P4310320402.name: John Benjamins Publishing Company
P4310320402.note: Hybrid linguistics journals. The submitted manuscript may be posted anywhere at any time; the accepted manuscript may go on a personal site, institutional or funder repository, and preprint servers after the version of record publishes. Gold OA APC is about EUR 1,800, waived under Read-and-Publish agreements.

P4310320079.name: Bentham Science Publishers
P4310320079.note: Subscription journals with a gold OA option (Open Access Plus) plus some fully OA titles. The accepted manuscript may be deposited on a personal site, institutional repository, PMC, or arXiv 12 months after publication; gold OA articles have no embargo. The final published version may only be archived under a funder mandate.

P4310311755.name: Intellect
P4310311755.note: Arts and media journals, mostly hybrid, with some diamond OA titles that charge no APC. Green self-archiving is supported, typically with an embargo for subscription articles - the OA FAQs page covers routes, fees, and the self-archiving policy. Confirm your journal's terms on its own page.

P4310320267.name: Pleiades Publishing
P4310320267.note: English-language editions of Russian-origin journals, distributed via Springer. Non-OA authors transfer exclusive rights to the publisher, so sharing is mainly via links to the published article; gold OA articles publish under CC BY with no embargo. Check the license page before depositing anything in a repository.
